status: PROPOSED: requires Abby consolidated brief approval; not a production implementation

selection.confirmed: boolean; only explicit selection or confirmation sets true

timestamps: integer UTC epoch milliseconds; expiresAt = createdAt + 86400000; now >= expiresAt invalid; no sliding extension

storage.fallback: memory only; no cookies/localStorage/server state introduced

validation: Reject unknown fields, invalid enums, duplicate URL keys, malformed JSON, nonfinite/future timestamps, expiry and unsupported schema/content versions.
Never merge stale host input over a later user selection.
Moon insight requires confirmed Moon; Mercury insight and application require both confirmed selections.
Selecting a changed sign invalidates derived application and recommendation; preserve the other confirmed selection.
Do not persist interpretation text, analytics identifiers, event history, birth information, names or account tokens.

transport.proposedHistory: namespaced host history.state for bounded pilot snapshots; preserve Wix history state fields; explicit opt-in protocol and frame mapping after approval; include instanceId and timestamps and validate against active instance before recovery

precedence: Explicit validated Back/Forward snapshot (within current journey and unexpired)
Current user action / newer accepted revision
Fresh validated entry link on a new navigation (requires confirmation; never inferred Moon from Sun)
Valid unexpired same-journey checkpoint for reload/recovery when no fresh conflicting link
reset: Revoke previous instanceId in the active runtime; purge prior checkpoint; create a new empty journey instance. If storage is available write the new empty checkpoint. Accept history only for a currently bound matching instance. With no storage after reload, do not revive unbound historical snapshots.
privacy: Guest preferences only. No calculated chart claim. No private data, credentials or durable profile.
instanceId: Random opaque functional journey instance; not an account ID and not sent to analytics.
